We need a route with at least 6 reactions using templates in order: ['20810','2895','1914397','1914398','1914399','74054'].

We have applied first three templates successfully, got products.

Now need to apply template 1914398 to appropriate precursor(s). The result from previous step gave two products: 'CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1' and 'O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2'. We need to apply 1914398 to one of these (or both) to get next precursors.

Check which matches template 1914398. We saw that first does not match. Check second.
